name: Egypt
summary: North African nation with Nile River valley and delta civilization bordered by arid Sahara. Confronts intense ambient dust combined with Greater Cairo vehicular emissions and Nile delta agricultural vulnerability.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 12.84x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); natural desert mineral dust mixes with dense urban vehicle and industrial exhaust.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; summer daytime highs frequently exceed 42 °C in Upper Egypt.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Elevated warming rate across eastern Mediterranean and North African desert corridors.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.7% share of global fossil emissions; dominated by natural gas power generation and transport.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Below world average per capita rate; energy efficiency initiatives active across industrial sectors.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Hyper-arid desert environment; virtually zero natural forest cover outside irrigated Nile buffers.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Anchored by Aswan High Dam hydroelectricity (7.1%) and expanding Benban Solar Park and Red Sea wind complexes.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 113 people/km²; 95% of population lives within the narrow Nile valley corridor.
